author: MandarinBeef84
body:
I'm MandarinBeef84 (Minecraft Username) and I was banned for excessive chat related infractions. I would like to be unbanned because I want to go back to the community I love. I strongly regret my actions that got me banned from my favorite server. I am very sorry for the level of immaturity I possessed when I received my kicks and temp bans for team griefing, excessive rudeness, not being respectful, etc. I have served my time and waited 25 days for you to consider me and it has given me time to realize how stupid I was to get banned for excessive chat violations. But not once have I been accused of hacking and I never will because, lets be honest, nobody likes a hacker. I am again, very sorry for my actions and I hope that this is enough to get me unbanned. I appreciate the time you take reading this and considering me.

                                                                                                                                                                                             Thank You,
                                                                                                                                                                                              MandarinBeef84.

title: Appealing my ban.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

You've had your chances and a temp ban for excessive chat offence yet you still decide to break the rules, time after time? I honestly don't believe you've served your time, you haven't done a one time crime you've continuously broken the rules countless times and that is why I've denied your appeal.
-Denied

Regards,
Aura
